question: How many field umpires are there in a cricket match?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Field Umpires:**

 
• **Two field umpires** are chosen, **one for the bowlers' end and one for the strikers' end**, to oversee the game.
 
• They will choose places from which they may readily observe any action that may necessitate their decision.
 
• After one inning for each team, the umpires will switch ends.
 
• The **striker's end umpire can decide to stand** either on the off side or the leg side of the pitch by informing the captain of the fielding side, the striker, and the other umpire.​</strong
